prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Desktop Pet Controls", "Here is how to interact with your pet once it appears on screen.", "Click and drag pet to move around screen", "Right-click pet for sleep, feed, and hide options", "Got It"]
1: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Review your companion registration before finalizing adoption.", "Official Pet Companion"]
2: ["Begin Your Pet Story", "Select your journey experience"]
3: ["Sign In to Preserve Your Pet", "Connecting your account ensures your companion and customization are safely saved.", "Sign in with your registered account to prevent pet profile resets.", "Automatic Cloud Save Enabled", "Sign In to Continue"]
4: ["Preparing Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet is getting ready to arrive on your desktop.", "Tip: Right-click your pet on desktop anytime for options.", "Toggle Soft Waiting Ambient"]
5: ["For best pet generation, upload clear photos with good lighting.", "Ensure single-subject focus and bright lighting for best pet quality."]
6: ["Choose Your Companion Path", "Swipe to explore available pet creation journeys.", "Select Adoption Path"]
7: ["Sign in to keep your virtual desktop pet safe across sessions.", "Cloud Save Protected", "Your pet customization and progress are linked directly to your account."]
8: ["Your Pet is Active on Your Desktop!", "Look at your desktop to meet your pet. Drag to reposition or right-click for controls.", "Pet is running directly on desktop display."]
9: ["Confirm Companion Selection", "Review your companion choice before proceeding to custom configuration.", "Confirm & Continue"]

verdicts.problem: Asks user to upload personal photos
